sources.snippet: BLIP: Bootstrapping Language-Image Pre-training for Unified Vision-Language Understanding and Generation Announcement: BLIP is now officially integrated into LAVIS - a one-stop library for language-and-vision research and applications! This is the PyTorch code of the BLIP paper [blog]. The code has been tested on PyTorch 1.10.

sources.title: GitHub - Sanskriti-Arya/blip-image-caption-generator: A multimodal AI ...
sources.snippet: A multimodal AI application that generates natural language captions for images using the BLIP (Bootstrapping Language-Image Pre-training) model. This project combines computer vision and natural language processing to generate descriptive captions for uploaded images using a pretrained transformer model.

sources.title: Understanding BLIP : A Huggingface Model - GeeksforGeeks
sources.snippet: BLIP (Bootstrapping Language-Image Pre-training) is a multimodal AI model that combines computer vision and natural language processing to understand both images and text together. It is trained on large-scale image-text pairs, enabling strong performance in vision-language tasks.
